limitations: Only the supplied PNGs were used. They are moderate-resolution JPEG-style scans, and fine marks were judged by eye at that resolution. All 16 checked marks are in the large type, where the strokes are distinct.

Each change was checked against the images first. working-pages.json was read only afterwards, to confirm that all 16 'after' forms are already in page330. In the working text the meteg comes after the vowel point (for example ֶֽ), which is acceptable.

Only the 16 provisional changes were checked. Possible metegs in the small type, and the other large-type candidates listed in the closure's limitations, were not checked, so the full-line fine-mark verification of s330 is still incomplete.
No source approval is given or implied. No files were edited.
